newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA to forge further into Hungary.
newsitem.headline: CA to forge further into Hungary.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein (CA) said on Friday it would continue to invest significantly in its commercial banking activities in Hungary despite losing out in its bid for Hungary's Magyar Hitel Bank.
Austria's flagship bank plans to expand its network in Hungary to around 20 branches by the end of 1997 from the present eight, CA spokesman Bernhard Grabmayr told Reuters.

Earlier today, Hungary's privatisation agency APV announced that Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV made a higher offer than CA to buy the country's fifth largest bank Magyar Hitel Bank (MHB), CA said in a statement.

But Creditanstalt is undaunted. Grabmayr pointed out that CA's bid is binding for 90 days from the date of submission -- October 17 -- and that should the final negotiations between APV and ABN AMRO come to nothing "then negotiations can continue with us."
